evidence.moment: A `--json --report` run prints JSON plus a report-saved line, so JSON.parse(stdout) threw; splitting the runs fixed it.

proposedChange.change: Add trap: never JSON.parse the full stdout of a gate `--json --report` run; parse the {..} slice or split the runs.

candidates.title: JSON-printing gate also prints a report path after the payload

evidence.moment: execSync('git show REV^:path') on Windows went through cmd.exe, consumed the caret, and silently injected the wrong revision.

proposedChange.change: Add trap: pass git revisions containing `^` via spawnSync argv, never a shell/execSync string.

candidates.title: cmd.exe eats `^` in git revision arguments

evidence.moment: Two full-tree fs.cpSync copies of .agents/skills dominated the suite runtime (~30-60s each on Windows).

proposedChange.change: Document: reuse one copied skills fixture and build extra fixtures minimally (only the files a check reads).

candidates.title: Full-tree skill fixtures are expensive; minimize copies
